recommendations.name: Conduit
recommendations.reason: Temporary shields help your teammates stay in a fight; faster jammers block a push.
recommendations.use: Stay close enough to support your fighting teammate, then use the barricade to make a push harder.

recommendations.name: Fuse
recommendations.reason: Explosive area pressure is more responsive, with Knuckle Jump now available in his base kit.
recommendations.use: Pressure an occupied angle with explosives so your team can follow up; save the jump when you need movement.

recommendations.name: Catalyst
recommendations.reason: Faster spike resets rebuild doors, while teammates can cross your wall without being slowed.
recommendations.use: Set up doorways before the fight and use the wall to screen a crossing or split enemy sightlines.

priorities.label: Revisit your setup
priorities.text: Catalyst, Fuse and Conduit have updated tools. Recheck upgrades before reusing an older composition.

priorities.label: Cover your team's jobs
priorities.text: Consider rotation, information and staying power together. These are planning roles, not a ranked popularity order.

priorities.label: Separate usage from strength
priorities.text: The event snapshot below predates this patch. Current post-patch strength and ranked pick rates remain unverified.

event.name: ALGS Americas Regional Finals
event.method: Manually reviewed public event snapshot. A legend's presence is counted once per team per match, not as a share of player slots. Bans affect availability. These observations do not establish current strength or ranked popularity.

compositions.purpose: Information, defensive utility and a portal route.
Cover pressure, a firing position and portal movement.
Layered cover, recovery and a squad redeploy.
compositions.tradeoff: Two support slots; no Controller for trap setup.

roles.name: Catalyst
roles.reason: Reworked door setup and friendlier wall crossings.
roles.strength: Door reinforcement and a screening wall.
roles.tradeoff: No longer immune to enemy Catalyst abilities.

roles.name: Fuse
roles.reason: Knuckle Jump now belongs to the base kit.
roles.strength: Explosive pressure, with faster weapon recovery.
roles.tradeoff: Knuckle Jump no longer reduces tactical cooldown.

roles.name: Conduit
roles.reason: Energy Barricade establishes its threat area faster.
roles.tradeoff: Temporary shields do not replace health recovery.

roles.name: Valkyrie
roles.reason: Skyward Dive carries teammates into a new skydive.

roles.name: Newcastle
roles.reason: Moving cover and protected revives support a reset.
roles.strength: Shields a revive while moving the ally.
roles.tradeoff: Cover and recovery do not supply enemy scans.

roles.name: Crypto
roles.reason: Drone scouting pairs with a shield-damaging EMP.
roles.tradeoff: A destroyed drone has a replacement cooldown.

compositions.name: Rotate, then establish cover
compositions.purpose: Reposition together, then set up a defensible foothold.
compositions.strength: Squad travel + door control + revive cover.
compositions.tradeoff: Squad travel depends on Skyward Dive being available.
compositions.useCase: A team practicing planned rotations and recovery.

compositions.name: Scout, pressure, sustain
compositions.purpose: Gather information before committing damage and shields.
compositions.useCase: A coordinated team choosing when to take a fight.

compositions.name: Supply a settled position
compositions.purpose: Bring nearby loot, defensive utility and recovery together.
compositions.tradeoff: No squad redeploy or dedicated enemy scan.
compositions.useCase: A team practicing position defense and resource management.

balance.name: Conduit
balance.summary: Faster jammer deployment; forward-line placement; new Level 2 upgrades.

balance.name: Fuse
balance.summary: Base Knuckle Jump and explosive resistance; quicker Motherlode explosions.

balance.name: Catalyst
balance.summary: Spikes rebuild doors; 15-second cooldown; allies cross Dark Veil freely.

balance.name: Bloodhound
balance.summary: Sonar snapshots fade sooner. The included August hotfix improved cloak behavior.

balance.name: Axle / Seer
balance.summary: Axle drone durability and stun reduced; Seer tactical turn-slow removed.

identity.Axle: Slide mobility and a seeking drone
identity.Catalyst: Doors, spikes and a screening wall
